모두의 비타민 40대 남성Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)허브큐어 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 5mg of Niacin, 167μg of Biotin, 8.8mg of Vitamin B1, 21μg of Vitamin B12, 4mg of Vitamin B2, 5.8mg of Vitamin B6, 333mg of Vitamin C, 14.9mg of Vitamin E, 10mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 5mg Niacin, 167μg Biotin, 8.8mg Vitamin B1, 21μg Vitamin B12, 4mg Vitamin B2, 5.8mg Vitamin B6, 333mg Vitamin C, 14.9mg Vitamin E, 10mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)허브큐어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water
